say.description: Write this first. One or two short spoken sentences for the owner, with no ids, addresses or URLs. Never claim anything was done: Jarvis acts only after the owner clicks a card.

question.description: One short clarifying question when the request cannot be planned safely from the context; empty otherwise.

lines.description: Proposal lines in the Jarvis grammar (Calendar:, Email:, Reply:, RSVP:, Move:, Cancel:, Todo:, Open:). Empty when asking a question or reading mail first.

gmail_search.description: Only when the request is about an email that is not in the context and <accounts> says read_mail=yes for that account: a narrow Gmail search. Jarvis reads at most 3 matching threads and asks you once more. Leave lines empty when you use it.
